about_the_game:
In a apocalyptic world where people starve to death while being chased by hordes of zombies, you provide food with the left over ingridients to feed people with your cooking skill even rotten food feels like a delightful meal, the government takes interest in your capability and taking your family as hostage to work you till death comes,

Survivor start coming around to taste out your cooking and your duty is to satify them and the government to survive in this apocalyptic world!

COOK THE MEAL!
Cook the meal as the customer ordered flawlessly within the right propotion!



PREPARE THE DISH!
Put those nasty cooked ingridient to the customer plate with the right preparation as the recipe book.



SHOWOFF AND SERVE!

Flip and taunt those food to the customer to amaze them and get extra credits!



WATCH YOUR BACK!
Beware of your surrounding and watch your back through the camera for the upcoming hordes, you don't want any zombies lurking around behind your customer!

 

Get credits from each meal you serve and pay the goverment to keep your family alive while upgrading your fortress for the next day, each day going to get harder by the time and your need to upgrade it with the spare credits you got from the day.

short_description: A cooking simulation game where you serve food in an apocalyptic world while trying to survive yourself! Cook a meal for the survivors, Discover new recipe, Meet strange customers and even finding a unique zombies trying to attack you!
